title: Surjectivity of the fibre map in a supplied affine free model
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], K an object of its derived category [def-pc-derived-category], s a point satisfying degreeZeroFibreSurjective X K s [def-sc-degree-zero-fibre-surjective], and U an affine open containing s. Let M be a bounded-above complex of finite free Gamma(X,U)-modules whose affine associated-sheaf complex [lem-pc-affine-perfect-module-model] represents K restricted to the over-site of U. If p is the prime corresponding to s under the canonical affine chart, then the canonical map kappa(p) tensor H^0(M) -> H^0(kappa(p) tensor M) [def-pc-module-cohomology-base-change] is an epimorphism. No Tor-amplitude or negative cohomology vanishing is assumed.

proof.text: The bounded-above finite-free complex M is K-flat by the module bounded-flat theorem, translating its acyclic-tensor formulation to the quasi-isomorphism localization API. The affine stalk base-change comparison proves that the transported stalk C of its associated-sheaf complex is K-flat.

proof.text: Choose the K-flat sheaf representative P in the fibre hypothesis. Its stalk is K-flat by the stalk criterion. The proved local_model_derived_stalk_iso identifies Q(P_s) with Q(C), using exact open stalks, the extension-restriction unit and the supplied local derived model. The proved naturality and common K-flat roof argument transport the given epimorphism to C.

theorem affine_perfect_fibre_surjectivity (X : Scheme.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    (K : schemeDerivedCategory X) (s : X) (hs : degreeZeroFibreSurjective X K s)
    (U : X.Opens) (hsU : s ∈ U) (hU : IsAffineOpen U)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    (M : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} (X.presheaf.obj (.op U))) ℤ)
    (hb : ∃ b : ℤ, M.IsStrictlyLE b)
    (hf : ∀ i : ℤ, Module.Free (X.presheaf.obj (.op U)) (M.X i) ∧
      Module.Finite (X.presheaf.obj (.op U)) (M.X i))
    (eM : Nonempty ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
      (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory.obj K ≅
        DerivedCategory.Q.obj
          (((Scheme.affinePerfectSheafification X U hU).mapHomologicalComplex
            (.up ℤ)).obj M))) :
    Epi (ModuleCat.cohomologyBaseChange
      (B := (hU.isoSpec.hom ⟨s, hsU⟩).asIdeal.ResidueField) M 0)
